articles.title: UBS pretax profits jump 27% in third quarter to $3.59 billion as wealth inflows surge
articles.summary: The Zurich-headquartered lender's common equity tier (CET) 1 capital ratio — a measure of a bank's solvency — reached 14.7% during the period, up from 14.4% the previous quarter. In its third-quarter earnings statement Wednesday, the bank said the integration of Credit Suisse is "firmly on track" to be completed by year-end, delivering a total of $13.7 billion in cumulative cost savings, above earlier expectations of $13.5 billion. The bank is seen as systemically important to the Swiss economy.

articles.title: Treasury yields tick higher ahead of Federal Reserve interest rate decision
articles.summary: Bond yields moved higher early Wednesday as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy decision, due later in the session. The 10-year Treasury note yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was more than 2 basis points higher at 5.0134%.

articles.title: Labubu-maker Pop Mart's shares extend declines as third-quarter sales plunge
articles.summary: Shares of Chinese toymaker Pop Mart, known for its popular Labubu dolls, added to their more than 30% decline so far this year, following a sharp decline in third-quarter revenue. Shares were last down under 2%, paring losses after declining more than 6% in early trading Wednesday. The steep sales decline raises questions about whether the frenzy surrounding Labubu and other collectible toys can sustain the company's rapid growth, particularly in overseas markets.

articles.title: Robinhood shares fall 5% as crypto slump weighs on profits, offsetting gains in new businesses
articles.summary: Robinhood shares fell in after-hours trading as investors digested a mixed third-quarter report in which transaction-based revenue missed Wall Street expectations despite growth in options trading and prediction markets. articles.title: Walmart says AI training is boosting confidence with the technology among its 2.1 million associates
articles.summary: As enterprise AI investment continues to grow, companies of all sizes are trying to figure out how employees feel about the technology in the workplace. What it found, based on more than 1.7 million survey responses, is that while workers have different levels of familiarity and comfort with AI, training and experience with the technology matters. "The people-led and tech-powered piece has been around for a while." Many workers across the economy say they are afraid of AI replacing their jobs.

articles.title: Oracle integrates ChatGPT, Codex into apps and expands cloud chip lineup
articles.summary: Oracle on Tuesday announced an expanded collaboration with OpenAI that brings the artificial intelligence lab's ChatGPT and Codex into the software maker's applications to make databases more actionable. Oracle also said Tuesday that it is making different hardware accessible on its cloud infrastructure, including Google's tensor processing unit AI chips and OpenAI's Jalapeño chip.

articles.title: Boeing shares slide on a disappointing cash flow update. Why this dip is buyable
articles.summary: The silver lining is that management took its medicine and reset investor expectations now, so the stock can mount a rebound once the dust settles. Shares of Boeing are down 10% Tuesday, on pace for their worst day since the April 2025 tariff panic . But markets are forward-looking beasts, and Boeing letting investors down on the cash-flow ramp in the coming years is, understandably, causing many investors to dump the stock Tuesday.

articles.title: Margin debt growth slows sharply as stock market warning signs build
articles.summary: The pace at which investors are borrowing money to invest in stocks has cooled substantially, raising concern that the stock market may be due for a fall. Recent FINRA data shows the annual growth in margin debt fell to 31.4% in September from 53.7% in May, Bank of America technical strategist Paul Ciana pointed out in a Friday note. Tesla investor Hy Luu, for example, refinanced his home to raise $30,000 to pay down margin debt during the stock's 2022 decline.
